versions.content: If the BswMDevErrorDetect switch is enabled, the BswM_- EthIf_PortGroupLinkStateChg parameters shall be checked for being in the al- lowed range. In case of an error, the BswM shall ignore the mode request and report to the Default Error Tracer with the value BSWM_E_REQ_MODE_OUT_OF_RANGE.
